description: This file defines an interface (IGraphRenderer) for rendering graphs, including methods for setting graph size, DPI, drawing, retrieving data points, scaling, moving, resetting ranges, and obtaining bitmaps. It is part of the Graphing::Renderer namespace and references external Direct2D interfaces.

classes.name: IGraphRenderer
classes.description: An interface for rendering graphs with methods for configuration, drawing, data retrieval, and bitmap extraction.

methods.name: SetGraphSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the graph in pixels.

methods.name: SetDpi
methods.description: Sets the DPI (dots per inch) for rendering.

methods.name: DrawD2D1
methods.description: Draws the graph using Direct2D factory and render target.

methods.name: GetClosePointData
methods.description: Retrieves data about the closest point to a given screen coordinate.

methods.name: ScaleRange
methods.description: Scales the current view range around a center point.

methods.name: ChangeRange
methods.description: Changes the display range based on an action.

methods.name: MoveRangeByRatio
methods.description: Moves the display range by specified ratios.

methods.name: ResetRange
methods.description: Resets the display range to default.

methods.name: GetDisplayRanges
methods.description: Retrieves the current display ranges for X and Y axes.

methods.name: SetDisplayRanges
methods.description: Sets the display ranges for X and Y axes.

methods.name: GetBitmap
methods.description: Retrieves the bitmap representation of the graph.
